story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: the World Almanac on their kitchen table and duplicating letters and mailing them out, licking the stamps themselves. Something nobody knows about Dave, but it’s true.

Very. His kids were great fun. I used to spend time with them over at his house. He had a beautiful Japanese-style house, with a rock that was on the property in the middle of his living room. The architect built it around the house that way. He kept it, I guess, waterproof and mice- and other rodents-proof, somehow. It was great to see this natural rock sitting there.
Yeah, in Oakland. Moving onto other artists, we should really get into Miles.
